data.text:
endpoints:
  # Pin only capability enum values accepted by the deployed LibreChat build.
  # Unsupported pseudo-capabilities such as memory, run_in_background and
  # ask_user_question must not be advertised here because schema validation is
  # fatal and prevents the API from starting.
  agents:
    capabilities:
      - deferred_tools
      - file_search
      - execute_code
      - web_search
      - actions
      - ocr
      - artifacts
      - subagents
      - context
      - skills
      - tools
      - chain
    skills:
      maxCatalogSkills: 100

  custom:
    - name: 'OpenRouter'
      apiKey: '${OPENROUTER_KEY}'
      baseURL: 'https://openrouter.ai/api/v1'
      # BEGIN MANAGED OPENROUTER MODELS
      # render-librechat-config.py replaces only this block in the runtime copy.
      # With no managed allowlist, keep the historical default and fetch the
      # complete provider catalogue.
      models:
        default:
          - 'deepseek/deepseek-v3.2'
        fetch: true
      # END MANAGED OPENROUTER MODELS
      titleConvo: true
      titleModel: 'deepseek/deepseek-v3.2'
      summarize: false
      forcePrompt: false
      modelDisplayLabel: 'OpenRouter'
